meta.scope: M3.5 beginner set: 200 unique simplified characters (not 200 words). Personal-use-first.
meta.selectionNote: Original, provisional selection for common beginner communication plus foundational components. It is NOT the official HSK 3.0 list and makes no claim of exact HSK membership. Per-character HSK level is intentionally absent until individually verified against the official syllabus.
meta.contentOrigin: Vietnamese meanings, example words and art briefs are original text written for this project. No third-party dictionary data copied.
meta.artworkStyle: Premium editorial digital painting / gouache, 4:3 (1600x1200 webp), detailed natural textures, depth, soft directional lighting, coherent muted palette; no text or characters inside the artwork.
meta.artworkStatusNote: All artwork pending. No image exists; the brief is a modern memory aid, never historical evidence.
meta.historyNote: No historical forms are claimed here; history lives in the sourced history manifest only.
